workflows.description: Trace token generation, regeneration at login, invalidation and lifetime settings in the supplied revision
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Analyze a bounded sample of issued tokens, or exercise the session library with controlled objects in a local harness
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.

workflows.description: Anonymous retrieval of the pre-login token and its attributes on the confirmed origin
prerequisites: Authorized same-origin requests through the scoped HTTP client on the confirmed origin, with the method, headers, cookies and body the approved scope declares.

workflows.description: Compare the sessions of controlled principals through login, replay, logout and a bounded wait; local HTTP alone is not identity
prerequisites: Operator-supplied authorized credentials for controlled authenticated principals, used only inside the confirmed origin.
